deepseek.title: Using DeepSeek — please review before continuing
deepseek.intro: DeepSeek is a third-party model provider based in China. Its data-handling terms differ materially from Anthropic and Google. Before selecting it, understand what this means for your data:
risks: Data location & jurisdiction: DeepSeek stores data on servers in the People's Republic of China and is subject to Chinese law, which can compel disclosure to authorities with limited legal recourse — unlike EU/US providers.
Your prompts leave your environment: everything a job sends — your project's source files, prompts, and generated code — is transmitted to api.deepseek.com.

Training & retention: DeepSeek's terms permit using inputs/outputs for service improvement and model training. Inputs are retained (roughly 30 days for inputs, longer for logs) and may be kept even after deletion for legal/compliance reasons.
Track record: public reporting (e.g. the January 2025 exposure of a DeepSeek database) underscores operational data-handling risk.
deepseek.acknowledgement: I understand DeepSeek is a third-party service outside ANT's control, and I use it at my own responsibility for any code or data sent to it.
